task.instruction: 将绿色方块放到红色方块上方（纯 RGB 模式）
task.evidence: 纯 RGB 模式完成绿叠红，无深度输入、未读取物体仿真坐标。抓取前侧视与腕部对绿方块的平面估计一致（0.3 毫米内）；放置后在同一帧对绿方块检验两种互斥假设：plane_z=0.025 给出中心 (0.2243,-0.0637)、extent 34×34 毫米，与放置前实测的红方块中心 (0.2201,-0.0630) 相距 4.4 毫米；plane_z=0 给出的中心偏离红方块 20 毫米。腕部相机独立复算给出 (0.2241,-0.0637)，与侧视相差 0.2 毫米，且 plane_z=0 假设下 extent 膨胀到 42×44 毫米，不符合 25 毫米方块，进一步排除“绿方块仍在桌面”的解释。红方块在侧视的可见轮廓从 162 格降到 8 格，说明已被上方物体遮挡。夹爪张开并先垂直后横向退开、静置 2 秒后的新双 RGB 图像显示堆叠保持直立未倾倒，腕部视角可见红方块顶面边缘承托绿方块。该结论为图像判断（codex_visual），非接触传感器或自动评分。

scene.name: workbench
scene.coordinates: world XYZ in meters; z=0 is the support surface
scene.perception: RGB only from the side and wrist cameras; no depth. 3D comes from the plane assumption: intersect a pixel ray with a stated horizontal plane, or give propose an object_height to estimate where an upright object of that size stands on the table. Object locations must still be observed, not assumed
scene.motion: IK with joint limits; no general collision-free path planner

cameras.note: side placement is a simulation starting point, not a calibrated copy of physical hardware

wrist.depth_note: no depth in the rgb modality; none is rendered or saved

perception.localize: method 'depth' is unavailable: no depth is rendered. method 'plane' with an explicit plane_z: the pixel ray is intersected with that horizontal plane. Depth-free and exact for content that really lies on the plane; wrong by the height error otherwise. This is the only 3D estimator in the rgb modality
perception.propose: rendered-colour regions as pixels and boxes, no surface point; pass object_height (and plane_z, default 0) to also estimate where an upright object of that height stands on the plane, and a grasp_center at half its height. Depth-free; assumes the object rests on the plane and is not badly occluded
perception.sources: rendered images, camera calibration and robot forward kinematics

perception.localize: method 'depth' is unavailable: no depth is rendered. method 'plane' with an explicit plane_z: the pixel ray is intersected with that horizontal plane. Depth-free and exact for content that really lies on the plane; wrong by the height error otherwise. This is the only 3D estimator in the rgb modality
perception.propose: rendered-colour regions as pixels and boxes, no surface point; pass object_height (and plane_z, default 0) to also estimate where an upright object of that height stands on the plane, and a grasp_center at half its height. Depth-free; assumes the object rests on the plane and is not badly occluded
perception.sources: rendered images, camera calibration and robot forward kinematics

command.evidence: 纯 RGB 模式完成红叠绿，无深度输入、未读取物体仿真坐标。任务开始时绿在红上，先拆垛：把绿方块从 z=0.025 抓起并放到桌面 (0.1872,-0.1268)（实测落点与目标差 2.6 毫米），再抓红方块叠上去。验证：同一帧对红方块检验两个互斥假设，plane_z=0.025 给出中心 (0.1895,-0.1280)、extent 36×32 毫米，与绿方块作为底座的实测中心 (0.1872,-0.1268) 相距 2.6 毫米；plane_z=0 给出 (0.1700,-0.1108)、extent 膨胀到 40×36 毫米，是假设平面低于真实支撑面的特征，且离绿方块 26 毫米。腕部相机独立复算 plane_z=0.025 得 (0.1897,-0.1279)，与侧视相差 0.2 毫米；其 plane_z=0 的 extent 为 44×46 毫米，同样排除“红方块在桌面”的解释。绿方块在侧视的可见像素从自由摆放时的 765 降到 270，说明上方被覆盖。夹爪张开后先垂直再横向退开、静置 2 秒，侧视图放大后可见单一竖直叠柱：上为红方块、下为绿方块，直立未倾倒，仅投下一个影子；黄色圆柱、紫色方块和蓝色目标区未被移动。该结论为图像判断（codex_visual），非接触传感器或自动评分。
